title: Baa Juice Pineapple 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Pineapple Nic Salt delivers the sweet, tropical taste of Pineapple in a bright and juicy profile. The flavour is simple yet satisfying, with its fruity tang keeping things lively from first puff to last. Part of the Baa Juice Bar Salts collection, this nicotine salt e-liquid is made with double-concentrated flavour for the kind of impactful taste associated with bar-style vapes. The 50VG/50PG ratio makes it ideal for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) vaping, ensuring clear flavour, discreet vapour and a smooth inhale. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Baa Juice Pineapple offers a classic tropical fruit option for pod kits and starter devices.
